Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, quãng đườn.en: According to Google Maps's instructions, the distance from the Chinese Gong to the North Jiang is approximately 1.18 km (11.750 km) if running along Route 1A is equivalent to about 33 hours. So the time of shipping from the Chinese to North Jiang takes about 4 to 6 days (time in the air to count delivery date, natural disaster, plague, hurricane, objective factor....)
Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, quãng đườn.zh: 根据Google Maps的指示,从"中克"到"北江"的距离为约1.18公里(11.750公里),如果沿着1A路运行相当于约33小时. 因此从中国人到北江的通航时间大约需要4到6天(在空中计算交货日期,自然灾害,瘟疫,飓风,客观因素. ).
